purpose: W2 release qualification: 2000-device provisioning and full-duration 25/s generator/capture validation at the exact W2 shape. Separate ID; not one of the 60 proposed attempts. NOT a fixed-point result and never reported as one.
deviations: Qualification only: separate run ID and seed; never counted as a proposed W attempt.

VU pool is rate-derived under the 2026-11-10 owner amendment: 150 VUs at 25/s (rate x timeout = 125, plus 10% headroom). The pool is generator concurrency, not a platform capacity claim; v1 qualifications at a fixed 150 are preserved negatives and are not retried.
Existing deployed state, device cohorts and history are retained; not a cold-start repetition.
